reviews.author: Donald Pandori
reviews.text: Showed up to check the price of an oil change for my truck and liked it so much that I did one on the spot. The guys are super thorough, knowledgeable, and professional. They also use high quality oil. In my case Synthetic Rotella T6 was used. I was in and out quickly and I loved that they sent the inspection report via text so I could look it over. I definitely recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Don Merritt
reviews.text: These guys are great!. The staff was interactive, fun and professional. The service was quick and accurate. They even offered some advice on a small issue with the truck that I had been worried about. I highly recommend anyone to stop in and have their vehicle serviced by these professionals in this clean and safe environment!

reviews.author: Similar Styles
reviews.text: Pretty disappointed. I was referred here on Facebook for a transmission issue and thought I’d be in good hands. When I first called, I specifically mentioned that I believed it might be a transmission issue and that I was hoping it wasn’t. I was told there’s a reason people get referred here, that their guys are good, and that they would take a deep look at it. After the diagnostic, I was told “Good news, the transmission is fine” and that the problem was torn boots, a bad mount, and worn struts/axles. I was charged $135.51 for the diagnostic, which I was told would not be applied to any service. I had never heard of that before. I explained my situation and that I wasn’t sure if I should move forward, but since I was told these repairs would fix the problem, I was willing to if they could work out the price. I was told they could possibly do that and that I would get a call back from the service advisor. That call never came. They quoted me close to $3,000, and my usual mechanic quoted about $600 less, so I went with them. The repairs matched what was quoted here, but the car was still jolting afterward. A transmission shop later confirmed it was the transmission all along. That is a $5,100 repair, and I would not have invested any money in other repairs had I known the transmission was shot. When I called back, I was told they did not actually go into the transmission. I asked if they pulled the transmission out and was told no, that they just run a bunch of different tests. I still don’t know what that means, how they checked it, or what part of the inspection actually involved the transmission. I also asked to speak with the manager and never got a call back. In the end, I am out $135.51 for the diagnostic and $2,300 in repairs that did not fix the issue. I did not move forward with the $5,100 transmission repair because the car is not worth that much, which is why I invested in the lower-cost repairs hoping they would resolve the problem. Unfortunately, they did not. This experience left me questioning the accuracy of their inspection and the follow-through on promised calls.

reviews.author: Nancy Edmunds
reviews.text: I haven't seen anything quick about the quick lube. I stood at the desk for a good 15 to 20 minutes and several employees past me and looked at me but no one bothered to say anything about them getting back with me or I'll help you in a minute. I finally asked an employee if they were too busy in he said no just haven't made it in there yet. Well I left.

reviews.author: Ryan Thomas
reviews.text: Awesome people, good private owned company no corporate BS. We will be back. They go above and beyond for their customers.

reviews.author: Blake Hollifield
reviews.text: During a hard time with Insurance etc, they got my car and made it super easy to bring it to a close. Thanks a bunch

reviews.author: Judge Fowler
reviews.text: These folks are great! This was my first experience with them and they really went above and beyond to get my vehicle back on the road!

reviews.author: Stephen Good Channel
reviews.text: To be honest I had faith in these people until today when I got the oil changed.. I was told two times I had a "transmission leak" around the cooler line.. One time when I previously got my oil changed and the second time today.. Im still yet trying to find this imaginary "leak".. I never seen any fluid on the ground let alone a shifting problem.. Let's be technical here.. first of all when you have a transmission leak it goes straight to the ground no matter what part of the transmission it is and secondly, when you have a transmission leak your transmission begins to slip due to the lack of lubrication on the gears and stuff.. Never experienced neither.. That's the school I went to.. So trying to pull a fast one is what made me lose my business with them for one and for two they don't know how to properly use a funnel because they spilled oil all over my motor and around my catalytic converter mounted in the front.. I noticed it whenever my car started smoking.. Also they didn't fill up my dipstick.. Seen a sign that says lack of employees.. Yeah, lack of good employees.. I think the owner just needs to find a new line of work and stick to what he's good at to be honest.. That place is going down the drain with the amateurs he hires and the lack of integrity lol.. Those numbers are going to be reducing pretty soon and the number of lawsuits is gonna go up lol..

reviews.author: Amy B
reviews.text: Quick, caring, professional service. Stick with the locally owned and operated, it pays off! These guys are great!

reviews.author: Quinn McNamara-Julian
reviews.text: These guys are awesome Friendly, professional, went out of their way and fixed my car quickly Don’t hesitate to do business with!

reviews.author: Ryan Mahaffey
reviews.text: very good guys at the quick lube and the lady at the front Lisa is awesome we use them for all of our fleet maintenance about 10 cars a month we send here and all the work is flawless !!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Lauren Willey
reviews.text: Always an easy stress free experience. These guys are organized and efficient as well as being honest and personable.

reviews.author: Diane Jarrard-Phillips
reviews.text: I've trusted these people for almost 20 years with doing my oil changes. They check everything while doing the change. Even vacuum your car out. Thank you TR Quick Lube!

reviews.author: Barry Dockery
reviews.text: Local folks doing a great job. I wouldn't take my explorer anywhere else for service. Much more than oil and lube. Check em out and tell them Barry said howdy.

reviews.author: Brian Masinick
reviews.text: Prompt, good service. Since moving to the Travelers Rest area, this has been the place to get routine lubrication service and I have been happy with the results and continue to do business in this store.

reviews.author: Matt Barton
reviews.text: Our Church broke down from out of state and they would offer ZERO help, offered to pay and everything but would not help until the next day. Unbelievably bad experience.

reviews.author: Mike Long
reviews.text: We were traveling and suddenly needed an oil change and tires checked. We were taken right in, no waiting, addressed our items, even replaced a bulb and vacuumed the floors! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Hector Flores
reviews.text: Awesome!!! Doing a cross country road trip. Called and took us in right away. Amazing customer service. Would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Tiffany Young
reviews.text: I took my car there to have the CV boot repaired I had other repairs to be done such as the oil pan leak I was told that the car had to sit over night so the seal can dry I took my car in. Thursday 8/11/2022 at 12pm I was told I should have my car back by Saturday I got my car back Friday 8/12 the other repairs was back tail light and a fog light side front the repairs estimate was $1,460 .but when I came to pick it up it was an extra $77 that I didn't have needless to say the problem with the CV boot still exists and the oil was never drained because it still reads the percentage when I brought it in 87% the only repairs I recognize is the tail light my aircondition needed repaired but he didn't fix that and claimed we didn't discuss that but we actually did because I knew his price quotes I will NEVER USE THIS SERVICE EVER AGAIN the previous owners were more honest with their customers

reviews.author: Derek Allmond
reviews.text: These guys are as good as you get. We take all of our cars there for everything. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ashley Toole
reviews.text: Been using them for a few years and always had a good experience. Good price and usually pretty quick depending on the time you go.

reviews.author: Megan Partin
reviews.text: Stopped by for an oil change when I was out of town and they went above and beyond! And got it done in an hour!

reviews.author: Josh Floyd
reviews.text: Fantastic service!!!! I take every car here an will always take my cars here! More than a quick oil change an great people!!!!

reviews.author: Halley Naille
reviews.text: Took way longer than 10 minutes they were kind and professional but they also never turned my oil change light off resetting it as well they wrote on the paperwork that they refilled my fluids and did not.

reviews.author: Glenn Pace
reviews.text: Did good job, friendly staff. Could have gotten a five, if staff had uniforms for professional appearance. Gotta look the part in order to play the part.

reviews.author: Zeke Whitworth
reviews.text: $120; for a standard oil change with synthetic?? FYI- $60 at Walmart, and $80 at AAA with certified mechanics! WHAT ARE THEY CHARGING SO MUCH FOR??? I'll never be back!

reviews.author: Tami Beall
reviews.text: Excellent quality and fast service- honest opinion on what I should do- came on my lunch break! Will def come again!!

reviews.author: cindy johnson
reviews.text: After charging 75$ for a oil change, came home to leaking oil all over concrete drive! Had to go back, then clean driveway once home... First and last time there!!!
